metadata.title: Goriely & Tabor (1998) PRL / McMillen & Goriely (2002) J. Nonlinear Sci. / Gerbode et al. (2012) Science — Kirchhoff Elastic Rod Tendril Perversion & G-Fiber Overwinding Reference Dataset

tendril_perversion_helix_specimen.organism: Passiflora caerulea (blue passionflower coiled tendril exhibiting perversion kink)

governing_equations.kirchhoff_rod_energy: E = integral_{-L/2}^{L/2} [ (B/2)*((kappa_1 - kappa_0)^2 + kappa_2^2) + (C/2)*(tau - tau_0)^2 - T*cos(theta) ] ds
governing_equations.critical_pitchfork_tension: T_c = B * kappa_0^2 / (1 + Gamma), where Gamma = C / B = 1 / (1 + nu)
governing_equations.helical_pitch_angle_law: cos(theta_helix) = 1 - ((1 + Gamma) / Gamma) * (1 - sqrt(T / T_c)) for T <= T_c, else 1.0

frenet_helix_curvatures.curvature_kappa: kappa = kappa_0 * sin(theta) / (sin(theta) + Gamma * cos(theta)*0 + 1) -> exact Kirchhoff equilibrium kappa_1 = sin^2(theta)/R_h, tau = sin(theta)*cos(theta)/R_h
frenet_helix_curvatures.perversion_kink_soliton: theta(s) = theta_helix * tanh(s / xi), tau(s) = tau_helix * tanh(s / xi), xi = sqrt(B / max(T_c - T, 1e-6))

governing_equations.topological_link_conservation: Delta_Lk = Tw + Wr = 0 => N_left = N_right (equal opposite-handed helical turns across perversion)
governing_equations.g_fiber_bilayer_intrinsic_curvature: kappa_0 = (6 * E_g * E_t * h_g * h_t * (h_g + h_t) * Delta_eps_g) / ((E_g * h_g^2)^2 + (E_t * h_t^2)^2 + 2 * E_g * E_t * h_g * h_t * (2*h_g^2 + 3*h_g*h_t + 2*h_t^2))
governing_equations.gerbode_overwinding_law: Delta_N(x) = N(x) - N_0; for soft young tendrils (Gamma = C/B = 0.25 < 1), dN/dx > 0 at low extension (overwinding up to +0.58 turns before unwinding at T -> T_c); for old lignified tendrils (Gamma = 1.45 > 1), dN/dx < 0 monotonically.

gerbode_2012_overwinding_regimes.description: Gerbode et al. (2012) Science 337:1087-1091 Fig. 3D-E & Fig. 4: Change in number of helical turns per half-tendril Delta_N as a function of normalized axial extension z / L for soft young tendrils (Gamma = C/B = 0.25) vs mature lignified tendrils (Gamma = C/B = 1.45)
